summary: Bill Huizenga voted in April 2024 to advance H.Res. 1117, opposing one-sided pressure on Israel regarding Gaza, and in May 2024 voted for H.R. 6090, the Antisemitism Awareness Act, which directs use of the IHRA definition and examples in Title VI education-discrimination enforcement. Both votes place him on the side of shielding Israel from external pressure and embedding the IHRA framework in federal education law.
